workLog.finding: MUST 7 makes a harness distinguish DID-NOT-APPLY from SURVIVED, and SHOULD 10 asks a regression test to be justified by a discriminating input, but neither covers the control itself. A probe whose edit is behavior-preserving for the case under test passes and reads as evidence. Measured twice in PR #5176: an inverted-control probe flipping != T1 to != T9 while the case ran tier=T3, so T3 sat on the same side of both; and a comment-skip test whose comment carried no jq token, so the extractor never read it and deleting the guard changed nothing.

build/scripts/generate_rules.py wrote 51 files and skipped 5 as all-internal scope. Both testing.instructions.md mirrors carry the new item, per knowledge-persistence.md MUST 2. No plugin manifest touched, per ADR-092.
